disagreement_analysis.issue_1_nonconvergence: SfePy neo-Hookean solve did NOT converge. Residual stayed at 99.9% after 1 Newton iteration. The solve 'completed' but the result is not physically meaningful.
disagreement_analysis.issue_2_material_mismatch: SfePy used deviatoric neo-Hookean only (dw_tl_he_neohook). FEBio used full neo-Hookean (deviatoric + volumetric). Missing bulk term in SfePy.
disagreement_analysis.issue_3_mesh_mismatch: SfePy used 16x8x8 (1024 elements). FEBio used 8x4x4 (128 elements). Different mesh sizes.
disagreement_analysis.issue_4_sfepy_evaluate_bug: SfePy v2026.2 has a bug in evaluate/create_evaluable API — region parsing fails when creating evaluation expressions. Had to compute Cauchy stress manually from deformation gradient.
disagreement_analysis.issue_5_sfepy_term_bug: SfePy v2026.2 has a bug in Term._check_variables — optional material arguments create tuples that cause AttributeError. Patched locally but the fix is fragile.

cto_assessment.decision: L3 = FAIL. Genuine cross-solver disagreement. Per CEO directive: 'investigate why, don't tune to match.'
cto_assessment.next_step: Fix SfePy convergence issue (add bulk term, check Newton solver settings, use same mesh). Then re-run L3.
cto_assessment.honest_statement: This is a GENUINE disagreement, not a bug to hide. The CEO said: 'If they disagree, don't hide the disagreement — make the AI explain and exploit it.' The disagreement is explained: SfePy's solve didn't converge.

validation_ladder.L3: FAIL — cross-solver disagreement (SfePy nonconvergence + material mismatch)
